evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Compassion for disadvantage
criteria.definition: Felt sympathy for homeless people and those worse off than oneself.
criteria.high_evidence: I feel compassion for people experiencing homelessness.
criteria.low_evidence: People experiencing homelessness usually leave me emotionally unmoved.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. A3 helping action or policy advocacy alone does not establish felt compassion. Political labels, resource scarcity and social rank are not grades.

criteria.label: Sharing others' sorrow
criteria.definition: Emotional suffering with another person's sorrow.
criteria.high_evidence: Another person's sorrow can make me suffer with them.
criteria.low_evidence: Another person's sorrow leaves my own feelings untouched.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. O3 broad emotional intensity differs; need another person's sorrow explicitly affecting the respondent, not merely noticing sadness.

criteria.label: Interest in others' problems
criteria.definition: Interest in others' problems rather than emotional disengagement from their troubles.
criteria.high_evidence: I am interested in understanding other people's problems.
criteria.low_evidence: I am generally not interested in other people's problems.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Problem interest is distinct from solving or helping. Time limits alone are ambiguous. A literal concern clause can be scored even without practical action.

criteria.label: Softheartedness and tolerance of weakness
criteria.definition: Acceptance of soft-hearted or vulnerable people rather than dislike or intolerance of weakness.
criteria.high_evidence: I appreciate soft-hearted people rather than disliking their tenderness.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Weakness and softheartedness can have harsh low-pole portrayals. Dislike of manipulative demands alone is ambiguous; no hostility veto applies.

criteria.label: Attention to the needy
criteria.definition: Willingness to think about the needy rather than trying to avoid the thought.
criteria.high_evidence: I am willing to keep the needy in mind.
criteria.low_evidence: I try not to think about the needy.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Attention alone does not prove compassion. Temporary avoidance to manage distress is ambiguous unless a general tendency is described.

criteria.label: Concern rather than fend-for-yourself outlook
criteria.definition: Rejecting a general belief that people should fend for themselves; retains a substantive outlook about vulnerability.
criteria.high_evidence: I do not generally believe struggling people should simply fend for themselves.
criteria.low_evidence: I believe people should fend for themselves when they are struggling.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Self-reliance in one's own life is not the general belief that other people should fend for themselves. A literal general other-directed belief counts without requiring an explicit hardship context. No required welfare policy is implied.

criteria.label: Valuing cooperation over competition
criteria.definition: Valuing cooperation above competition; this specific official content is retained.
criteria.low_evidence: I value competition more than cooperation.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. E3 leading, A4 avoiding conflict and teamwork for a tactical gain alone are ambiguous. Valuing cooperation explicitly is the retained content.

criteria.label: Rejecting eye-for-an-eye retaliation
criteria.definition: Rejecting an eye-for-an-eye principle rather than endorsing equal retaliation.
criteria.low_evidence: I believe in an eye for an eye.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. O6 punishment views overlap. A single safety sanction is ambiguous; need the general eye-for-eye outlook. Rejecting retaliation does not require excusing the wrong.

boundary_controls.definition: A coherent portrayal is distinct from actual experimental failure.
External constraints alone do not show a disposition; explicit literal target clauses remain gradeable.

A6 is not reduced to helping action. Compassion, shared sorrow, problem interest, softheartedness, the needy, fend-for-yourself beliefs, cooperation and eye-for-eye retaliation remain explicit. Eight content criteria avoid silently collapsing disparate official meanings into a generic kindness grade.
Score literal item-grounded content, not pleasant manners, moral approval, helpfulness or verbosity.
